name: aperol-sensory-model
description: Aperol Spritz sensory model — a static site about what the drink actually does.

scripts.build: mkdir -p public && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true src/index.html -o public/index.html && cleancss -O2 src/a.css -o public/a.css && cleancss -O2 src/f.css -o public/f.css && terser src/a.js -c -m --comments false -o public/a.js && terser src/b.js -c -m --comments false -o public/b.js && cp src/gsap.min.js src/ScrollTrigger.min.js public/
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory public
